pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.2: tena kho pana samayena aññatarena upāsakena saṅghaṃ uddissa vihāro kārāpito hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.3: so tassa vihārassa mahe ubhatosaṅghassa akālacīvaraṃ dātukāmo hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.4: tena kho pana samayena ubhatosaṅghassa kaṭhinaṃ atthataṃ hoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.5: athakho so upāsako saṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.7: athakho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.12: yadi saṅghassa pattakallaṃ saṅgho kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyya.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.16: yassāyasmato khamati kaṭhinassa uddhāro so tuṇhassa
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.1.18: uddhataṃ saṅghena kaṭhinaṃ. khamati saṅghassa tasmā tuṇhī. evametaṃ dhārayāmīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.1: athakho so upāsako bhikkhunīsaṅghaṃ upasaṅkamitvā kaṭhinuddhāraṃ yāci.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.4: athakho so upāsako ujjhāyati khīyati vipāceti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.5: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo amhākaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ na dassantīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.6: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tassa upāsakassa ujjhāyantassa khīyantassa vipācentassa.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.7: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.8: kathaṃ hi nāma ayyā thullanandā dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhissatīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.9: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhatīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.12: hi nāma bhikkhave thullanandā bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāhissati
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.14: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:1.2.15.1: yā pana bhikkhunī dhammikaṃ kaṭhinuddhāraṃ paṭibāheyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-pc30:2.1.8: kathaṃ idaṃ kaṭhinaṃ uddhareyyāti paṭibāhati āpatti pācittiyassa.
